security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Radar overlay of confirmed, currently spawned cubes
bundle.longDescription: A transparent, always-on-top radar that shows only cubes a validated data source confirms are spawned right now. Ships with a synthetic simulator; reads no game memory and modifies no traffic.
